about: The repository's expected settings (greenrepo UPK-15), by the field names of GitHub's REST API, grouped by the
endpoint that reads them. `reader` is whose login can: `workflow`, the health workflow's own token, compared
weekly into the health issue; `admin`, the maintainer's, compared in the monthly session with
`bun scripts/health.ts --admin`. Only the fields named are compared; drift is reported, never applied. The
rulesets are in rulesets/, as GitHub exports them; the secrets and deploy keys are checked against renewals.toml.
MAINTAINING.md's "Repository settings" says the same in words.

settings.about: Public, with main the default branch; issues and pull requests open to everyone; no wiki, projects or discussions; the docs site as the homepage
Squash, merge or rebase, as the change needs; merged branches deleted; secret scanning with push protection, security updates
Vulnerabilities reported privately, as SECURITY.md says
GitHub Pages built by a workflow (pages.yml), at the address the install lines are run from
The `github-pages` environment, which pages.yml deploys through, reached only by the refs it names
Pages deployed from `main` only: a push there, and the runs by hand that releases and previews start
Dependabot alerts on; GitHub answers 204 when they are, 404 when not
CodeQL's default setup, with the workflows (`actions`) among its languages
Actions on, each action pinned by its full commit hash
The workflow token read-only by default, unable to approve pull requests
A published release's files and tag locked
No webhooks; one added is listed here, with its secret
The maintainer signs in with two factors; GitHub shows it to its owner, with the read:user scope
